parent: h01 (putting_away_Halloween_decorations) / p01: localisation, map prior, routes, whole-body IK, arm planner, pinches
summary: First controller for cleaning_up_plates_and_food. The two bowls and the two plates with their pizzas are found on the breakfast table from the head camera's colour and depth images (white rings at the table's height; a pizza's orange inside a plate's ring). Each bowl is taken by its rim from a table end and let go over the sink's basin. A plate that a hand reaches only from the table's south end is first moved to the north half when there is room there (the open fridge door shuts the way into the gap by the fridge). The fridge's right door is led open by its handle to 105 degrees from a stance east of it. Each plate (fingers 75 degrees down) is taken by its rim, drawn in slowly and carried level, the localiser correcting the pose all the way; at the fridge the base stands east of the opening facing west, the plate goes to the opening (the arm planner keeps the plate's rim off the open door), a look at the plate puts its place in the hand right, it is slid in as far as the arm reaches, lowered and let go, and the closed hand pushes it in to the shelf's depth; the second plate goes onto the first one's pizza. The door is shut: the free edge is pinched across the door's thickness (tried again further in along the door if the fingers closed on nothing) and led to 17 degrees (from beyond 80 degrees first to 62 from a stance 0.2 m nearer the door), then the handle is taken and led to shut, and the closed hand presses the door's outer face home (at once if the handle was missed with the door nearly shut); tried up to five times, each from a fresh look at the door.
